extra_args.description: Official Tencent Hy3, FP8 checkpoint (tencent/Hy3-FP8, 101 shards, ~300 GB). hy_v3 architecture: 80L, hidden 4096, 192 routed experts / 8 per-tok + 1 shared, GQA 64H/8KVH, vocab 120832, MTP n=1. Served on vLLM 0.22.0 (native hy_v3 tool + reasoning parsers and HYV3MTPModel spec-decode). That venv bundles CUDA 13, so its nvidia/*/lib dirs are injected via LD_LIBRARY_PATH (box only has CUDA 12.8/12.9). 4x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, TP4, 200k, fp8 KV cache, chunked prefill, MTP=1.

extra_args.concurrency: 4 sessions share the ~643K-token KV pool (validated: 4x ~157K = 630K simultaneously, all retrieved correctly)
extra_args.description: lukealonso/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 (246B NVFP4) on 4x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (SM120). SGLang harness from 0xSero/minimax-m3-nvfp4-sglang. Launcher: ${HOME}/launch_minimax_m3_nvfp4_studio.sh (docker foreground; appended args ignored). Patched image minimax-m3-sglang:dev-cu13-minimax-m3-patched (built on first launch). Tuned like the MXFP4 minimax-m3-sm120 recipe: ctx 250000, max-running-requests 3 (3-way concurrency), multimodal ON (image+video) via --enable-multimodal, --limit-mm-data-per-request {image:4,video:1} to avoid worst-case video profiling headroom (SGLang analogue of vLLM --skip-mm-profiling). quant modelopt_fp4, kv bfloat16, moe flashinfer_cutlass, cuda-graph decode=full prefill=disabled, chunked-prefill 4096, max-prefill-tokens 16384, mem-fraction-static 0.95. Do NOT add --disable-cuda-graphs or --enforce-eager.
key_fixes: hidden_act silu->swigluoai (config): dense MLP + shared experts need clamped SwiGLU (alpha=1.702, limit=7.0); plain silu caused total garbage.
sparse_disable_index_value per sparse layer: lightning indexer has no value/output proj; otherwise index_v/index_o_proj left NaN -> garbage attention.
quant ignore list block_sparse_moe->mlp: shared experts ship BF16, must not be quantized to fp4.
moe_layer_freq derived from mlp_layer_types: dense layers 0-2.
loader: gate/up/down_proj->w1/w3/w2, indexer->index_, e_score_correction_bias rename, fused gate_up_proj split.
clamped-SwiGLU plumbed into flashinfer cutlass fp4 MoE via swiglu_alpha/beta/limit (patch_modelopt_moe.py).
extra_args.verified: 2026-06-15: WORKING. Coherent text, reasoning+tool-call parsers, image+video all validated on 4x RTX PRO 6000 (SM120).

extra_args.description: Full mamba-cache config re-verified 2026-06-11: flashinfer mamba backend + fp16 SSM cache with stochastic rounding (philox 5) + prefix caching (mamba_cache_mode auto=all) + MTP. MOE_BACKEND must stay auto: model is mixed-quant (NVFP4 main MoE rejects triton, unquantized MTP-draft MoE rejects marlin). Do NOT set MAMBA_CACHE_MODE, LINEAR_BACKEND, or ATTENTION_BACKEND.
extra_args.limitations: With mamba prefix caching on, KV pool is 376,988 tokens (1.44x at 262k) vs 1,048,576 (4.00x) without - each 4480-token attention block carries an SSM-state snapshot. Two full 262k prompts cannot be resident simultaneously. Concurrent Partial Prefill unsupported.

extra_args.description: StepFun Step 3.7 Flash FP8 via vllm/vllm-openai:stepfun37 on four RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs. CUDA graphs enabled, 262144-token context, max_num_seqs 4, max_num_batched_tokens 8192, and MTP speculative decoding with 6 draft tokens. The model rejects 8 speculative tokens because Step MTP n_predict=3 requires divisibility by 3.
extra_args.launch_command:
docker run --rm \
  --name step37-flash-fp8-vllm \
  --gpus '"device=0,1,2,3"' \
  --ipc=host \
  --shm-size=64g \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  --ulimit stack=67108864 \
  --network host \
  -v ${MODEL_ROOT}/Step-3.7-Flash-FP8:/model:ro \
  -v ${MODEL_ROOT}/hf:/root/.cache/huggingface \
  -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 \
  -e CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID \
  -e HF_HOME=/root/.cache/huggingface \
  -e OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 \
  -e SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU=1 \
  -e NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 \
  -e NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 \
  -e NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo \
  -e GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=lo \
  -e NCCL_DEBUG=WARN \
  -e NCCL_CUMEM_HOST_ENABLE=0 \
  -e PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True \
  -e VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=INFO \
  -e VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0 \
  vllm/vllm-openai:stepfun37 \
  --model /model \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port 8000 \
    --served-model-name step-3.7-flash \
    --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
    --enable-expert-parallel \
    --disable-cascade-attn \
    --reasoning-parser step3p5 \
    --enable-auto-tool-choice \
    --tool-call-parser step3p5 \
    --speculative_config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":6}' \
    --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"reasoning_effort":"low"}' \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --max-model-len 262144 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
    --max-num-seqs 4 \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
    --disable-custom-all-reduce
